name: Foreknowledge
overview: Scripture reveals that God's foreknowledge is comprehensive and intimate, encompassing all aspects of our lives even before our formation, as seen in Jeremiah's assurance that God knew and sanctified him before birth (Jeremiah 1:5) and the psalmist's declaration that God is fully aware of every word and detail of our being (Psalms 139:4,16). Isaiah affirms God's sovereign control over history, declaring the end from the beginning and ensuring that His counsel and purposes will be accomplished (Isaiah 41:4; 46:10). This foreknowledge is grounded in God's loving intentions for His people, promising a future of peace and hope (Jeremiah 29:11).
